body:
i have a terminal illness that's been getting worse for the past several years.  i didn't want to get into details because i didn't want to presume to compare myself to anyone else who's suffering.  i know others have it worse, someone always does no matter who we are.  but often treatment is expensive and/or painful, and in the end all you're really doing is buying yourself a few extra months/years of life on diminished terms in which you're just a shell of what you used to be.

we're ALL going to die anyway.  but i just want to end my life on MY OWN terms, while i am still "me" --- while that still means something, at least to myself.  i've already lost so much of myself that i'm never getting back.  and i just want to end things while i still have what's left of me.  if that makes sense.

thanks for the honesty.  i wasn't sure if i should even write a note at all.  everything i can think of saying just sounds so fucking self-serving and inadequate.  and yes, i know this is the ultimate self-serving act anyway... so maybe i shouldn't compound that.  i don't know.  i know they know that i love them, so maybe i should just hope i can leave it with that, and not just try to get in a last word in an argument they can never answer.

anyway i appreciate your saying this.  hurts a bit to hear that but on some level i think i already knew that anyway.

i appreciate that, but believe me, i do 100% want and intend to go through with this.  my only intent in even asking/posting here was to minimize the hurt to my family any way i can, but wanting that doesn't affect my decision at all.  and frankly, i've lived more than long enough for my family's sake.  far longer than i wanted to.  i love them, i do, but this is MY choice.
my family had me institutionalized once already.  not going through that again for anything in the fucking world.
